detail: The defect reproduces only under a clean npm ci on the CI runner's Node version, where react-native resolves to its Flow-typed ESM entry; the developer machine's Node and pre-existing node_modules resolve a parsable path, so no test executed inside this repository's policy worktrees reproduces it. The fix pins resolution with a jest moduleNameMapper stub, verified by wiping node_modules and running the CI job's exact steps locally.
issue: CI run 30586599662, job react-native-sdk, step Parity + unit tests (jest)
missingCapability: CI-runner Node and clean-install resolution inside a policy worktree
